dialogue.text: As the legend goes, in the distant past, there was a beautiful woman called Chon-a.
dialogue.zh: 傳說很久以前，有一位美麗的女子叫做嫦娥。
dialogue.ja: 昔々、遠い昔に嫦娥という美しい女性がいました。
dialogue.local: As the legend goes, in the distant past, there was a beautiful woman called Chon-a.
dialogue.en: As the legend goes, in the distant past, there was a beautiful woman called Chon-a.

dialogue.text: Her husband, Ho-i, was a brilliant archer.
dialogue.zh: 她的丈夫后羿是一位出色的弓箭手。
dialogue.ja: 彼女の夫、后羿は優れた弓の名手でした。
dialogue.local: Her husband, Ho-i, was a brilliant archer.
dialogue.en: Her husband, Ho-i, was a brilliant archer.

dialogue.text: At that time, there were ten sons in the sky, and the people on earth were living in a blistering heat.
dialogue.zh: 當時天空中有十個太陽，地上的人們生活在酷熱之中。
dialogue.ja: その頃、空には十の太陽があり、地上の人々は猛暑の中で暮らしていました。
dialogue.local: At that time, there were ten sons in the sky, and the people on earth were living in a blistering heat.
dialogue.en: At that time, there were ten sons in the sky, and the people on earth were living in a blistering heat.

dialogue.text: To save the earth, Ho-i used his bow and arrow to shoot down nine at the suns.
dialogue.zh: 為了拯救大地，后羿用弓箭射下了九個太陽。
dialogue.ja: 地球を救うために、后羿は弓矢で九つの太陽を射落としました。
dialogue.local: To save the earth, Ho-i used his bow and arrow to shoot down nine at the suns.
dialogue.en: To save the earth, Ho-i used his bow and arrow to shoot down nine at the suns.

dialogue.text: Ho-i was respected as the national hero and received an elixir of immortality, as a reward for saving the people from the heat of multiple sons.
dialogue.zh: 后羿被尊為國家英雄，並獲得了長生不老藥作為獎勵，因為他拯救了人們免受多個太陽的酷熱。
dialogue.ja: 后羿は国の英雄として尊敬され、複数の太陽の暑さから人々を救った報酬として不老不死の霊薬を授かりました。
dialogue.local: Ho-i was respected as the national hero and received an elixir of immortality, as a reward for saving the people from the heat of multiple sons.
dialogue.en: Ho-i was respected as the national hero and received an elixir of immortality, as a reward for saving the people from the heat of multiple sons.

dialogue.text: However, the elixir only had enough for one person, and both Chon-a and Ho-i didn't want to lead each other.
dialogue.zh: 然而，這瓶靈藥只有一份，嫦娥和后羿都不想讓對方先服用。
dialogue.ja: しかし、その霊薬は一人分しかなく、嫦娥も后羿もお互いに先に飲ませたくありませんでした。
dialogue.local: However, the elixir only had enough for one person, and both Chon-a and Ho-i didn't want to lead each other.
dialogue.en: However, the elixir only had enough for one person, and both Chon-a and Ho-i didn't want to lead each other.

dialogue.text: But one day, when of Ho-i's students tried to steal the elixir when he wasn't home.
dialogue.zh: 但有一天，后羿不在家時，他的一位學生試圖偷走靈藥。
dialogue.ja: しかしある日、后羿が留守の間に彼の弟子の一人が霊薬を盗もうとしました。
dialogue.local: But one day, when of Ho-i's students tried to steal the elixir when he wasn't home.
dialogue.en: But one day, when of Ho-i's students tried to steal the elixir when he wasn't home.

dialogue.text: In order to protect the elixir from thieves, Chon-a took the magic elixir of immortality.
dialogue.zh: 為了保護靈藥不被小偷奪走，嫦娥服用了這瓶神奇的長生不老藥。
dialogue.ja: 霊薬を盗人から守るために、嫦娥はその不老不死の霊薬を飲んでしまいました。
dialogue.local: In order to protect the elixir from thieves, Chon-a took the magic elixir of immortality.
dialogue.en: In order to protect the elixir from thieves, Chon-a took the magic elixir of immortality.

dialogue.text: Then she flew to the moon and became the moon goddess, leaving her husband behind.
dialogue.zh: 然後她飛向月亮，成為月亮女神，留下了她的丈夫。
dialogue.ja: そして彼女は月へ飛び、月の女神となり、夫を地上に残しました。
dialogue.local: Then she flew to the moon and became the moon goddess, leaving her husband behind.
dialogue.en: Then she flew to the moon and became the moon goddess, leaving her husband behind.

dialogue.text: Alone on earth, Ho-i missed his wife so much that he made an offering to the moon and tried to find the shape of Chon-a on the moon.
dialogue.zh: 后羿獨自在地上，非常思念妻子，於是向月亮獻祭，試圖在月亮上尋找嫦娥的身影。
dialogue.ja: 地上に一人残された后羿は妻をとても恋しがり、月に供え物をして嫦娥の姿を探そうとしました。
dialogue.local: Alone on earth, Ho-i missed his wife so much that he made an offering to the moon and tried to find the shape of Chon-a on the moon.
dialogue.en: Alone on earth, Ho-i missed his wife so much that he made an offering to the moon and tried to find the shape of Chon-a on the moon.

dialogue.text: To remember Chon-a, Chinese people worship the moon by eating fruit and moon-shaped desserts called mooncakes.
dialogue.zh: 為了紀念嫦娥，中國人會吃水果和月餅這種月亮形狀的甜點來祭拜月亮。
dialogue.ja: 嫦娥を偲んで、中国の人々は果物や月の形をした月餅を食べて月を祀ります。
dialogue.local: To remember Chon-a, Chinese people worship the moon by eating fruit and moon-shaped desserts called mooncakes.
dialogue.en: To remember Chon-a, Chinese people worship the moon by eating fruit and moon-shaped desserts called mooncakes.

dialogue.text: This is the legend of the origin of the mid-on festival, which is also called the moon festival.
dialogue.zh: 這就是中秋節的起源傳說，中秋節也被稱為月亮節。
dialogue.ja: これが中秋節、別名月見祭りの起源にまつわる伝説です。
dialogue.local: This is the legend of the origin of the mid-on festival, which is also called the moon festival.
dialogue.en: This is the legend of the origin of the mid-on festival, which is also called the moon festival.

dialogue.text: Nowadays, the mid-on festival, which is also a harvest festival, has become a family holiday like Thanksgiving.
dialogue.zh: 如今，中秋節同時也是一個收穫節，成為像感恩節一樣的家庭節日。
dialogue.ja: 現在、中秋節は収穫祭でもあり、感謝祭のような家族の祝日となっています。
dialogue.local: Nowadays, the mid-on festival, which is also a harvest festival, has become a family holiday like Thanksgiving.
dialogue.en: Nowadays, the mid-on festival, which is also a harvest festival, has become a family holiday like Thanksgiving.

dialogue.text: Most people celebrate the mid-on festival by having a large dinner with family.
dialogue.zh: 大多數人會與家人共進豐盛的晚餐來慶祝中秋節。
dialogue.ja: 多くの人は家族と一緒に豪華な夕食をとって中秋節を祝います。
dialogue.local: Most people celebrate the mid-on festival by having a large dinner with family.
dialogue.en: Most people celebrate the mid-on festival by having a large dinner with family.

dialogue.text: Where should be the moon with gifts, traveling, viewing lantern shows, eating various desserts, and flying lanterns to pray for their happiness and the happiness of their families.
dialogue.zh: 人們會賞月、送禮、旅行、觀賞燈會、吃各種甜點，並放天燈祈求自己和家人的幸福。
dialogue.ja: 人々は月を眺め、贈り物をし、旅行をし、灯籠祭りを見物し、様々なデザートを食べ、幸福と家族の幸せを祈って灯籠を飛ばします。
dialogue.local: Where should be the moon with gifts, traveling, viewing lantern shows, eating various desserts, and flying lanterns to pray for their happiness and the happiness of their families.
dialogue.en: Where should be the moon with gifts, traveling, viewing lantern shows, eating various desserts, and flying lanterns to pray for their happiness and the happiness of their families.

dialogue.text: Research Chon-a highlights mid-on festival to get more information.
dialogue.zh: 研究嫦娥可以更深入了解中秋節。
dialogue.ja: 嫦娥について調べることで、中秋節についてもっと知ることができます。
dialogue.local: Research Chon-a highlights mid-on festival to get more information.
dialogue.en: Research Chon-a highlights mid-on festival to get more information.
